title: Emergency Management and Homeland Security - Emergency Medical Services

program.section_heading: Emergency Management and Homeland Security - Emergency Medical Services - Associate of Science Degree and Certificate of Achievement - MAS1088/C/MCE1088
outcomes: Recognize the types of natural, manmade, and technological hazards that can negatively impact a community.
Compare and contrast various forms of National and International Terrorism.
Distinguish the fundamental roles and responsibilities of the professional emergency manager.
Demonstrate skills necessary to prepare for, mitigate, respond to, and recover from manmade and natural disasters.
Demonstrate the skills necessary to function in the EMS branch of the Incident Command System.

notes: The page prints one combined section for the A.S. Degree and Certificate of Achievement; the program requirements and the Program Learning Outcomes are shared by both awards and are recorded here for the A.S. Degree.
The heading is printed three times, twice with program code MAS1088/C/MCE1088 and once with MAS1016/MAS1016/MAS1016C/MCE1016; a reviewer may want to confirm which program code applies.
The catalog prints codes with a hyphen (e.g., HLS-1, EMS-50); these were matched to closed-list entries HLS 1 and EMS50 and not treated as catalog additions.
The closed list stores no units for EMS50; the catalog prints 5.00 units for EMS-50.
The degree text refers to general education requirements 'as described in the college catalog' without naming a GE pattern, so ge_pattern is null.
